msgs.text: morning tex
Morning, Luis. Good night's sleep?
not really. slept badly, coffee is doing the heavy lifting
the raccoons got into the bins again
my neighbour says they are basically tiny landlords at this point
Ha. A bungee cord across the lid usually slows them down.
we tried that. they unclip it with their hands apparently
anyway. moving on
what's a good name for a sourdough starter, asking for a friend who is me
Something you can say with a straight face at 6am. Mildred, Gus, or Dough Whisperer.
gus. gus is going in the notes app now
started the dough last night, it smells like beer which is apparently normal
my flatmate says it smells like feet. we disagree
I'm not calling it a success yet
that's the most time I've spent on bread since college
A starter smells sour and funky in the first week, that's normal. Give it time before you judge it.
fair. ok thanks tex
I've been reading a book about lighthouses, the author spends eleven pages on one staircase
eleven pages. I counted
I'm loving it anyway, it's the good kind of slow
they used to paint the stripes on lighthouses so ships could tell which was which
that's a good fact to have
ok my coffee's gone cold so that's the end of that
the kettle's on again, second go
the lighthouse book is coming with me on the bus
I'll read the staircase bit again for the fun of it
Done, it's on your calendar for 3.
perfect thanks
honestly the best part of my morning so far
my sister sent a photo of her new puppy wearing a raincoat
it is the most dramatic animal I have ever seen
she says the puppy hates the rain but loves the coat, which is the wrong order of priorities
the cat in a box that's too small thing is a whole meme format now
I'm going to write a list of films for the weekend, top of it is the new sci-fi thing everybody's been talking about
second is that old comedy with the bus
nobody remembers the bus one but me
anyway I'm the only one who likes the bus one, which is fine
the rain is supposed to clear by lunchtime
good, gus needs a walk too
he doesn't, he's a jar
I'm allowed to joke about him, he's in my kitchen and he's lovely
ok the coffee has finally kicked in
back to work, the report isn't going to write itself
The library closes at 6 today, ha.
haha
lol that puppy story is still making me laugh
I need a proper lunch today, not the sad sandwich again
I've been eating the same three lunches for a month
my body is basically a bus timetable at this point
the bread is going to be a problem, gus is sulking in the cupboard
he has not risen at all since I fed him, he is lying there like a tired pancake
apparently you're supposed to wait a few days, which means I'm grumpy about it
my flatmate says I'm checking on the jar every hour
which is true, I'm not going to pretend otherwise
the group chat is fighting about a team name for the five-a-side, nobody agrees
I want the Quizzly Bears, everybody else wants something ruder
I'm told that's not the sort of thing I get to decide alone
the rain has finally stopped which means the streets smell like wet bins
sorry, that's a horrible image
I'm going to go find something to eat that isn't a sandwich
ok that's the plan, a proper lunch and no more jar watching
Booked the 7:30 table.
thanks but I asked for 8
Sorry, I got that one wrong. Do you want me to ask them to change it to 8?
no stress, I'll ring them myself. sorry for the sharp tone
you're fine, it's just annoying when a thing is wrong and it's the thing you asked for
Fair enough. Getting the time right matters more than anything else on a booking.
agreed. I'm going to have a sit down with a cup of tea and read the menu
the menu has a dessert with a name I can't pronounce and I'm keen on it
sticky toffee should be a crime to skip
the weather's changed again, now it's sunny and the bins are dry
which is the only thing I care about
lol gus is still in the cupboard, he's refused to come out
I'm going to try a bit of warm water at the mouth of the jar
my flatmate says that will make him sad
they're giving him a hard time in the house
right, I need to put the kettle on and do something about my shoulders
my shoulders have been up by my ears since monday
stretching now, back in a bit
how long does cooked rice keep in the fridge
Cooked rice keeps about 3 to 4 days in the fridge. Cool it quickly, seal it, and reheat it until it's steaming all the way through.
good to know, I had it in the bowl for two days and felt vaguely guilty
rice is one of those things you think is fine until it isn't
a relative of mine always said you don't leave rice out, ever
I'm going to get a better container, the ones I have are a mess
the lid doesn't close properly and the whole thing smells of curry
curry has ruined a perfectly good tupperware, it's a crime
anyway I have a list of new containers to buy
the kitchen shop on the high street had a sale last week I think
or maybe it was the hardware place, I'm honestly not sure
anyway the sun's out so I'm going for a walk
the park has a dog that runs at every pigeon, a total hero
the pigeons are unimpressed
I've got my headphones on, the podcast is about old maps
they were really inaccurate and the sea monsters were the best part
Reminder: your passport renewal form is due this week.
thanks, I'll fill it out tonight
sea monsters were on maps for ages, lol
someone put a whale where the coast should have been and just went with it
I love when history is wrong and completely confident about it
anyway I'm home and my shoes are wet
the park was lovely but the path was basically a river
lots of puddles, very annoying to walk through
gus is still in the cupboard, nothing has changed
I bought a dishcloth that is the wrong shade of yellow
it's fine, it'll do
the cat next door keeps sitting on my windowsill
she's allowed in, she just doesn't come in
that's cats for you
dinner is going to be whatever's left in the fridge
which is the usual, a bit of everything
tidying the kitchen first before I get on with anything else
the radio's playing a song from when I was a kid, I know every word and I'm not proud of it
Done, the car wash is on your calendar for 10.
thanks! push it to 11 though
Moved the car wash to 11. It's on your calendar for 11 now.
perfect, that gives me time for breakfast
I forgot the car is so dirty it's basically a mud flat
it's been through three fields and a farmyard this month
I'm not blaming the car, I'm blaming the lanes
the lanes near the farm are a disgrace
my sister says it's character, I told her character doesn't pay for the wash
I've got a new podcast on the go about bridges, very relaxing
they went into the history of a bridge that fell down twice
the second time they rebuilt it out of the same bricks
that's either brave or foolish
I would have been the one asking for a refund
honestly an afternoon off right now would be me on the sofa and nothing else
the sun went in again
they said rain by four, which is a lie, it's already spitting
fine, I'll go and find a jumper
how long do hard boiled eggs last
Hard boiled eggs in the shell keep about a week in the fridge. Once peeled, eat them within a day or two.
a week, got it. I've got six sat on the side from the weekend
they're in a box with a sticker that says eat by something, I don't trust it
anyway I'll take a couple to work for lunch, a bribe for myself
lunch is a new habit I'm trying to get into
the thing about lunch is you actually have to leave the desk
which is the hardest bit
the office kettle makes everything taste of limescale
so I've started bringing my own mug
it says world's okayest uncle, my nephew gave it to me
it's the best mug I own
the nephew also drew a horse on the side, which is less good
my head's gone to mush from the afternoon heat
the air conditioning in here is a disgrace
I keep thinking about switching to a standing desk
I'll look into it when my head clears
put renew passport on my todo list for this week
Added to this week's list.
lovely, one less thing in my head
I've been meaning to get a plant for the desk for ages
the plant shop by the station does a good line in succulents
I just keep killing them, which is embarrassing
my cousin says you can't kill a succulent, which is a challenge to me
give me a cactus and I'll find a way
I did a thing with a sponge earlier that involved too much water
it dripped all over the desk and a bit of the keyboard
the keyboard is a bit sticky now, lesson learned
back to the list though, next up is the bins, who knew
lol the bins again
the bins are going to win this year
I'll clean the bin lid with a bit of bleach and make it everyone's problem
anyway I'm making a cup of tea, the good one
the one with the biscuit in the pack
ok that's me for a bit, got to finish a report
three dinner options around $10 a person for 30 people

fd.draft: Mains run about $1 to $2 a person. The sides, dessert and drinks aren't priced yet, next step is pricing those.

msgs.text: I'm working on three dinner options for 30 people around $10 a person. I'll come back with the mains first, then the sides, dessert and drinks.
ok good, that's what I needed to hear
the caterers always take forever to reply so I'll chase them
honestly the hardest part is picking things that everybody likes
my mum will want something with no onions, my brother will want onions in everything
I'll put the options in the group chat and see what chaos follows
that's not a plan, that's a warning
thanks for the help today tex
I think I'm done for the day, my eyes are fried
the last bit of the report is almost there
I'll leave it till the morning and look at it fresh
fresh eyes are the only eyes that work
the street lights are on now
I'm going to make a proper dinner with whatever's in the fridge
night, speak tomorrow
